blocking_findings.summary: The actual exam question is not visible enough in the right-side task flow.
Actual-exam task 1 uses a value bank, role bank, and repeated value/role rows, causing cognitive overload.
Task 3 does not consume the calculated answer from task 2 and should be direction-first.
Textbook graph construction is still typed point entry rather than a primary click-to-place workspace.
The graph workspace reveals P/Q axis and number labels before axis selection.
Visual QA accepts mechanical scrollability while the source pane remains cropped or awkward.
